# Qlavo — GEO Agency

Qlavo is a generative engine optimization (GEO) agency founded in 2025 by Ansh Bhatia. Headquartered in New Delhi, India, Qlavo works with businesses worldwide on AI-search visibility. Enquiries: ansh@qlavo.co.in.

## Services
GEO research and strategy, buyer-question visibility checks, entity consistency, content improvements, technical optimization and reporting. Two fixed plans: three months at $900 or ₹90,000, and six months at $1,500 or ₹1,50,000. Scope, deliverables and timing are agreed in writing before work starts. AI recommendations, rankings and leads are not guaranteed.

## Agency partnerships
White-label GEO is a service offered by Qlavo, not a separate business or an exclusive company identity. Agency partners retain their client relationships and present agreed deliverables under their own brands. No direct client contact without agency consent. Partner pricing is scoped privately; a paid pilot can be discussed for a defined project.
